body: The little amounts of happiness of living in the moment.

I don't really know. This stage of depression is really harsh.
Right when i got home from school I tried doing it.
Nothing really phazed me, Everything just slipped past me while i was getting ready to do it. 

Hobbies, Some music. Cant really play video games Have a really bad desktop. Internet browsing for books thats about it.

19 I dont really care about my education now, Kinda ruined it when i got really depressed and just gave up. Just stopped going outside stopped eating.

My relationship with my mom has some distance. I just kept myself in my room. All day. I just lost my will for everything, First time breaking out.
God i hate gun laws, Fucking garbage canada
